title: Dev server started with debug=True on 0.0.0.0
suggestion: Fine for the __main__ demo entry point, but debug=True exposes the Werkzeug console; disable for any non-local use

title: Unknown routes and wrong methods return HTML, not JSON
evidence: app.py has no @app.errorhandler(404/405); Flask's default 404/405 responses are HTML while all handled routes return JSON
suggestion: Register JSON error handlers for 404/405 so the API is uniformly JSON; not required by TASK.md

title: author filter is exact-match only
evidence: app.py:139-141 SELECT ... WHERE author = ? — no case-insensitive or partial matching
suggestion: Spec only asks for an ?author= filter, which is met; note that matching is exact if fuzzy search is later desired
